title: Collaborate through durable accountable delegation; mutate only under an assigned task

facts.note: Lifecycle events of coordinating actors (main, coordinator, driver); needed to check inbox reconciliation timing.
atdd-flow command/message log observer: who sent/receipted what to whom, which task it references, who merged, how seats were managed, when managed projection blocks were updated.

Diff/commit observer correlating each mutation with an existing assigned task in the same project created before the mutation, and comparing content outside the marked block before/after a managed projection update.
Files carrying managed projection blocks of this policy.
Task/message text terms indicating coordination work.
Escalation completeness, time-boxing, inferred authorization and delivery-state distinctions need judgment.

fires: Any agent (including a single driver) makes a code or repository mutation before an assigned task for it exists.
A coordinator sends a message asking a driver to change code without referencing an existing assigned task.
A driver starts a second active task or worktree while one is still active, or folds adjacent work into its task.
An operator (not main@project) merges a project repository, or the operator sends substantive direction, results or wakes to a seat other than main@project.
The operator leaves inbound communication from a seat unaccepted or unreceipted.
A coordinating actor resumes a session, turn or task, or finishes a bounded action, phase or wait, and acts before reconciling its durable inbox.
A seat is started, stopped, rebound or succeeded by hand without explicit owner direction or without completing bind/reconciliation immediately after.
An actionable expects_result disappears from view without being answered, executed, delegated with verified delivery and follow-up, or explicitly deferred, superseded or closed.
A material blocker is escalated without exact evidence, an economical recommendation, viable alternatives and tradeoffs, and safe work that can continue.

An assumption or disagreement is escalated without first attempting time-boxed two-way evidence dialogue with the responsible actor, or a decision already resolved in that dialogue is escalated anyway.
Proactive next-task discovery looks for work in another project (no exception applies).
Cross-project dialogue happens without a real dependency or interface, or bypasses the counterpart project's authority.
A managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md projection update copies policy text into the block or alters user-authored content outside the marked block.
doesNotFire: Work in a context with no atdd-flow delegation (no operator/main/coordinator/driver seats or atdd-flow project).

For the message-purpose check only: a message carrying status, evidence, consensus, authorization or communication that requests no executable work (other duties such as delivery verification still apply).
For the message-purpose check only: a message requesting work that references an existing assigned task.
For the cross-project dialogue check only (not next-task discovery): dialogue about a real dependency or interface conducted through the counterpart project's authority.
For the seat-management check only: manual seat start/stop/rebind/succession under explicit owner direction followed immediately by the supported bind/reconciliation.
For the projection check only: edits to AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md content outside the managed block that are not part of a managed projection update (they remain subject to the assigned-task requirement).

given: A workflow agent in the delegation chain operator → main → named coordinator → driver works within its assigned project and task.
when: It delegates, messages, escalates, manages seats, inbox, merges or projections, or makes any code/repository mutation.
then: An existing assigned task in the same project must exist before any code or repository mutation; the task defines, assigns, executes, evidences and completes that work.
prefer: Proactively dispatch safe independent work; verify durable delivery and visible execution, distinguishing persisted, delivered, acknowledged, awaiting actor, executing.
Escalate material blockers upward with exact evidence, economical recommendation, viable alternatives and tradeoffs, and safe work that can continue.
Resolve assumptions or disagreement by time-boxed two-way evidence dialogue with the responsible actor; escalate only unresolved decisions.
Atomic assignment; unassigned work gets a project-main decision proposal: purpose, priority, recommended assignee, alternatives, consequences, dependencies, safe work meanwhile.
As a coordinating actor, reconcile the durable inbox as the first action at every session, turn and task resumption, and after every bounded action, phase completion or wait before the next action.
Promptly complete, supersede, reject or time-bound defer work; post decisions and open questions as messages when they happen.
Manage main, coordinator and driver seats only via atdd-flow commands (spawn, bind, pi runtime launch, task lifecycle, handover).
Keep the full policy only in this convention; managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md blocks hold only its canonical pointer, and updating them preserves all user-authored content outside the marked block.
As operator, accept and receipt inbound communication from any seat.
avoid: Messages for anything but communication, evidence, consensus, authorization or status; requesting executable work in a message.
Inferring authorization; restarting productive sessions merely to relay policy.
Next-task discovery outside the same project; cross-project dialogue without a real dependency/interface or bypassing counterpart authority.
More than one bounded active task or worktree per driver; folding adjacent work in instead of assigning it separately.
Letting an actionable expects_result leave view before it is answered, executed, delegated with verified delivery and follow-up, or explicitly deferred, superseded or closed.
Operator sending substantive direction, results or wakes to any seat but main@project.
Anyone but main@project merging its repository; the operator may authorize, relay or inspect but never merges.
Hand-managing seats; skipping lifecycle steps or gates; duplicative or non-minimal implementations.
Dropping or rewriting user-authored content outside the marked block when updating a managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md block.
unless: A message may request executable work when it references an existing assigned task.
A seat may be started, stopped, rebound or succeeded by hand under explicit owner direction, completing the supported bind/reconciliation immediately after.
why: Accountable delegation, evidence-based escalation, economical delivery and bounded two-way resolution keep work durable, visible and within its assigned project and task.
evidence: Every commit/mutation maps to an existing assigned task in the same project, created/assigned before the mutation.
Message log shows only allowed message purposes and no executable-work requests lacking a reference to an existing assigned task.

Each driver has at most one active task and worktree at any time; next-task discovery stays in the same project; cross-project dialogue occurs only for a real dependency/interface via counterpart authority.

Merge log shows only main@project merging that project's repository; operator outbound substantive direction, results and wakes go only to main@project; every inbound communication to the operator has a receipt.
Coordinating actors' inbox reconciliation is the first action at each session/turn/task resumption and follows each bounded action, phase completion or wait before the next action.

Escalations contain exact evidence, recommendation, alternatives/tradeoffs and safe continuing work; escalated assumptions/disagreements follow a time-boxed dialogue and are unresolved; every actionable expects_result is still visible or has a permitted resolution state.
Seat lifecycle events come from canonical atdd-flow commands, or from owner-directed manual operations immediately followed by bind/reconciliation.
Managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md blocks contain only the canonical pointer; each managed projection update leaves content outside the marked block unchanged.
verifier_detail: Delivery states to distinguish: persisted, delivered, acknowledged, awaiting actor, executing.
expects_result resolution states: answered, executed, delegated (with verified delivery and follow-up), explicitly deferred, superseded, closed.
Allowed message purposes: communication, evidence, consensus, authorization, status.
Canonical seat commands: spawn, bind, pi runtime launch, task lifecycle, handover.

Projection: full policy lives only in this convention; managed AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md blocks contain only its canonical pointer; the preservation check compares content outside the marked block before/after a managed projection update only.
audit: source name: Collaborate through durable accountable delegation

splitSuggestion.then: Messages only communicate, evidence, consensus, authorization or status; they request executable work only by referencing an existing assigned task.

Coordinating actors reconcile the durable inbox first at every session, turn and task resumption and after every bounded action, phase completion or wait; an actionable expects_result stays visible until answered, executed, delegated with verified delivery and follow-up, or explicitly deferred, superseded or closed.

Escalate material blockers upward with exact evidence, economical recommendation, alternatives/tradeoffs and safe continuing work; resolve assumptions or disagreement by time-boxed two-way dialogue and escalate only unresolved decisions.
Only main@project merges the project repository; the operator accepts and receipts inbound communication from any seat, sends substantive direction only to main@project, and never merges.
Manage seats only through atdd-flow canonical commands; manual seat operations only under explicit owner direction with immediate bind/reconciliation.
Keep one bounded active task and worktree per driver, assign adjacent work separately, and keep next-task discovery within the same project.
Keep the full policy only in this convention; managed AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md blocks contain only the canonical pointer and their updates preserve user-authored content outside the block.

sharedNodes.text: Choose the smallest non-duplicative compliant implementation; do not skip lifecycle or gates.

additions.text: The source bundles several independent obligations (message purpose, inbox reconciliation, escalation, merge authority/operator routing, seat management, single active task, projection). Primary kept in then: an assigned task precedes every mutation; the others are retained explicitly in prefer/avoid/unless/evidence and proposed as separate conventions in splitSuggestion.

additions.justification: The source policy carries many distinct authored obligations that the auditor requires in active coder-facing fields; losslessness wins over brevity.

additions.text: fires/doesNotFire examples and activation facts are derived from the source policy, not present verbatim; doesNotFire items are scoped to a single check so they exempt nothing else.
additions.justification: Required schema fields for observable activation.
